description: WHAT: Stub pointer only — NOT the page body. summary says to use ai-pages or HTML. RETURNS path (locale prefix stripped). USE get_ai_page or get_serp_snippet for real text. path optional (default /).

locale.description: HTML locale for canonicalUrl and path prefixes. de = default, URLs have no prefix (https://www.ikeytz.com/preise). en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr = prefix /{locale}/ (https://www.ikeytz.com/en/preise). Omit or empty = de. Does not change prices, phone numbers, or legal German names. Not a maps.ikeytz.com locale (maps is German-only).

path.description: Optional marketing path. Omit or empty = /. Examples: /preise, /en/preise, /kontakt. Locale prefix stripped in the return path.

name: get_page_summary
title: Get Page Summary
